description: Your wallet's signed launch: Souvenir checks it is the prepared one (your wallet may only add its compute budget or guard instructions), adds the coin's own signature and sends it. Answers { signature }. Then launch_status. Takes the token from sign_in, as token or as the request's Authorization: Bearer header. Refused with "Launching through the API is not open yet." while it is not open to your wallet. Launching a coin, in order: (1) sign_in_challenge with your wallet's address, sign its message with that wallet, then sign_in for a token; (2) launch_options, and search_prizes for the prize (or shopper_sample for a coin that picks its own prizes); (3) prepare_launch; (4) sign the transaction it answers with your wallet, without sending it, and give it to submit_launch; (5) launch_status until it answers confirmed: a pump.fun launch first answers split with a second transaction, which you sign (or sign and send) and give to submit_split, then launch_status again. Your wallet pays and signs everything: Souvenir never needs or asks for its private key.

token.description: The token sign_in gave. Not needed when the request sends it as Authorization: Bearer <token>.

transaction.description: The same, as one string instead of a list.

transactions.description: The transaction prepare_launch answered, signed by your wallet, base64.

name: submit_launch
title: Send a signed launch
